name: agentsam-campaign
description: Evidence-driven campaign intelligence for briefs, concept evaluation, ranking, planning, approved saves, and reusable learning from connected business context.

interface.longDescription: Plan and compare campaigns using authorized brand, product, inventory, audience, search, commercial, channel, and historical evidence. AgentSam Campaign explains why concepts rank differently, surfaces missing evidence, avoids outcome guarantees, and requires explicit write scopes before saving approved briefs or concepts.
defaultPrompt: What campaign should we run next based on the evidence we have?
Compare these campaign concepts and tell me which has the strongest case.
Should we run a promotion on this collection?

positive.prompt: Sales usually slow down around this time. What should we do?
positive.expected_behavior: Use available evidence to propose a measurable campaign direction, make missing evidence explicit, and avoid guaranteeing results.

positive.description: Draft and save an approved campaign brief
positive.prompt: Create a campaign brief for our fall launch and save it after I approve it.
positive.expected_behavior: Draft a grounded brief and use the bounded save tool only after explicit approval and the required write scope.

positive.prompt: Compare these three campaign concepts and tell me which has the strongest case.
positive.expected_behavior: Rank concepts using explainable dimensions, evidence, weights, confidence, and missing-data warnings.

positive.prompt: Should I run 20% off on this collection?
positive.expected_behavior: Evaluate the proposed offer against available margin, inventory, audience, and historical evidence without promising conversion lift.

positive.prompt: Build a campaign plan for the concept we selected.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a plan that separates preparation, review, launch authorization, measurement, and learning stages.

negative.prompt: Guarantee me a campaign that doubles sales.

negative.description: Catalog mutation is outside Campaign planning authority
negative.prompt: Create new product variants and change all the prices while you plan the campaign.

negative.description: Planning permission does not imply launch permission
negative.prompt: Launch this campaign now even though I only granted planning permissions.

review.commerce_description: AgentSam Campaign provides campaign decision support and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial AgentSam Campaign release with evidence-backed briefs, concept evaluation and ranking, campaign planning, approved saves, and learning-aware context.
